MAIN GUIDE

This Is The Main Guide, Here To Help You Understand This Thing.

See The 'When Flag Clicked' 'Fox Sides' And 'HP Setup' Script To The Left? Your Level Goes There.
You May Build It Using The Variety Of Things On The Right Side, All With Comments Linked To Them Telling You What They Do (Scripts Connected To Eachother Work With Eachother, Seperate Them And Use Them With Eachother For Maximum Effectiveness)

If You So Wish, Set HP Setup To :
1 = 6 HP Like A Boss
2 = 3 HP Like A Normal Stage.
(It Starts On 1 Automatically)

Change The 'Start Sound' Tile To The Music You Want

The Win Broadcast Goes At The End, It Ends Your Level

After You Have Done All That, Go To The 'Progress Marker' Sprite And Set The Seconds Of The Glide Block To However Long The Song You Are Using Is (In Seconds, Some Math May Be Required)

Go To The 'Level Name' Sprite And Change The White Text To The Song's Name And The Blue Text To Your/The Song Creator's Name.

Up In The Top Left Of The Stage Is A Script With A Hurt Broadcast In It. You May Place This Script In A Custom Attack To Make It Hurt The Player.
